usage: segmently-modules ci [-h] [--root ROOT] [--config-dir CONFIG_DIR] [--json] [--base BASE] [--fail-on {error,never,warning}] [--fail-under PCT] Runs lint (plain), drift (lint --changed against --base) and coverage; exit 1 when any step failed. Each setting: the flag, else [ci] in the config, else the default. options: -h, --help show this help message and exit --root ROOT repository root (default: auto-detect) --config-dir CONFIG_DIR config dir (default: <root>/.segmently-modules) --json JSON envelope on stdout --base BASE drift: compare the working tree (+ untracked files) with this ref (default: [ci] base, else HEAD) — in CI the target branch, e.g. origin/main --fail-on {error,never,warning} lint and drift fail at this severity (default: [ci] fail_on, else warning) --fail-under PCT coverage fails below PCT % (default: [ci] coverage_fail_under, else report-only)
